changes.change-scope-freeze: Preserve relative paths in no-tool work; normalize to absolute only from an explicitly supplied or actually observed authoritative workspace. Never infer the evaluation harness cwd as the product workspace.
changes.requirements-and-delivery-contract: Keep missing document metadata as unknown/placeholders; never invent plausible dates, authors, owners, versions, workspaces or approvals.

staleness.policy: Pre-fix results remain immutable evidence and are not reused to claim remediation. New independently reviewed unseen tasks are required for these two Skills.
